name: Ksarik
body:
KSARIK
CR 4

XP 1,200
N Large plant
Init +1; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (–1 size, +1 Dex, +7 natural)
hp 37 (5d8+15); fast healing 2
Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +3
Immune plant immunities

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
Melee tentacle +8 (1d6+7 B plus ingested adaptation)
Ranged acid spit +4 touch (1d12 acid) or thorn dart +4 (1d6+5 P plus carrion spores, max. 100 ft.)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks ingested adaptation

STATISTICS

Str 20 (+5), Dex 13 (+1), Con 17 (+3), Int 4 (–3), Wis 14 (+2), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +3; CMB +9; CMD 20 (24 vs. trip)
Feats Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Acrobatics +1 (+5 to jump), Climb +13, Perception +13

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Acid Spit (Ex)

As a standard action once every 1d4 rounds, a ksarik can spit a glob of acid as a ranged touch attack at a target within 60 feet.

Ingested Adaptation (Su)

A ksarik can make a single attack with its tentacles as a primary natural attack. Whenever a ksarik deals damage to a living creature with its tentacles, it siphons off a portion of the target’s genetic code and psychic resonance, temporarily reshaping its own physiology and psychology to match its victim’s. This grants the ksarik one of the following abilities (provided the target has it) for 1 minute:

Blindsense (up to 60 feet)
Blindsight (up to 60 feet)
Darkvision (up to 60 feet)
Damage Reduction (up to 5/—)
Resistance to one type of energy damage (up to 20 points)
Burrow (up to 40 feet)
Fly (up to 40 feet, with maximum of average maneuverability)
Swim (up to 40 feet)
Water breathing

Alternatively, the ksarik can gain the ability to understand (but not speak) up to three languages that the target knows, gain the target’s weapon proficiencies (its tentacles can operate two-handed weapons in this state), or change the damage dealt by its acid spit ability to any one energy type dealt by one of the target’s supernatural attacks.

A ksarik can maintain only one adaptation at a time, and gaining a new adaptation ends the previous one.

Thorn Dart (Ex)

A ksarik can fire one of its thorns as a ranged attack. The dart has a range of 100 feet with no range increment, deals piercing damage, and exposes the target to carrion spores.

Carrion Spores—type disease (injury); save Fortitude DC 15; onset 1 hour; frequency 1/day; effect 1d2 Con damage; when an infected creature has taken 5 or more points of Con damage, 1d10+10 diminutive ksarik seedlings burrow out of its flesh and wriggle away; this ends the disease and deals 1 piercing damage for each ksarik seedling; cure 2 consecutive saves. (The save DC is Constitution-based.)

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm forests
Organization solitary, pack (2–5), or infestation (6–11)
Treasure incidental

Ksariks are mobile, carnivorous plants found on numerous warm jungle planets throughout the Galaxy. Their original homeworld is unknown, as is the means by which they have become so widely distributed—although it may have something to do with their uncanny ability to absorb genetic material from those they come into contact with and temporarily borrow evolutionary adaptations from them.

Ksariks have colorful bodies that incorporate both plant and animal characteristics. Their bodies look like powerful great cats, but they have leaf-like sails growing from their backs and vine-like tentacles where their faces should be. They use the longest of these tentacles somewhat like an elephant might use its trunk.

Ksariks are powerful and willful, and are not easy to tame, although many have tried.

They scavenge as much as they hunt, and this has made them less aggressive than some of the creatures one might encounter in the jungle—and yet they remain highly unpredictable.
